name: autopilotDevices
description: Windows Autopilot device identities with their enrollment state, group tag and profile assignment

metadata.name: profileAssigned
metadata.valueExpression: {{ (() => { const v = $['deploymentProfileAssignedDateTime']; if (v === null || v === undefined || v === '' || (typeof v === 'object' && v.__isNone)) { return null; } const t = new Date(v).getTime(); return isNaN(t) || new Date(t).getUTCFullYear() <= 1901 ? null : new Date(t).toISOString(); })() }}

metadata.name: lastContacted
metadata.valueExpression: {{ (() => { const v = $['lastContactedDateTime']; if (v === null || v === undefined || v === '' || (typeof v === 'object' && v.__isNone)) { return null; } const t = new Date(v).getTime(); return isNaN(t) || new Date(t).getUTCFullYear() <= 1901 ? null : new Date(t).toISOString(); })() }}

metadata.name: managedDeviceRef
metadata.valueExpression: {{ (() => { const v = $['managedDeviceId']; const s = typeof v === 'string' ? v.trim() : ''; return s && !/^[0-]+$/.test(s) ? s : null; })() }}

metadata.name: entraDeviceId
metadata.valueExpression: {{ (() => { const v = $['azureActiveDirectoryDeviceId']; const s = typeof v === 'string' ? v.trim() : ''; return s && !/^[0-]+$/.test(s) ? s : null; })() }}
